timeline.body:
I think this would never be null:
* if the stream is empty then `.get(0)` will throw no such element
* if the stream contains the null then `.toList()` will throw NPE when constructing.

I wonder if that should be something like `findFirst` or collecting the entire list and asserting its size is at least 1?

reply.body: `getResponses` could have `null` in it. For each ID we get one item in the list, but that item could be null. But you are right that the way I've changed the code already makes that check unnecessary. I've simplified it in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/96796/commits/29aa20d124c44fe0cb06c48a237dc1c73b8e4e18.

timeline.body: nit would be simpler to delete first element of idsToIndex. that way you'd be able to write directly assertions on the first and second element.

reply.body: The randomized simplified version is ok I think.
